theme: Industrial Forge / Estación de Forja Inmersiva
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / INDUSTRIAL HEAVY METAL FORGE

headings.h1_title: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-white drop-shadow-[0_4px_12px_rgba(245,158,11,0.3)]
headings.h2_showcase: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter text-amber-100
headings.h3_section: text-xs sm:text-sm font-black uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-amber-400/90 flex items-center gap-2
headings.card_title: text-base font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-white truncate

code_and_labels.sub_labels: text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-amber-500/80

forge_aesthetics: Industrial riveted metal plates with subtle top highlight and bottom inner-shadow
Molten heat gradient backing (radial amber-orange glow under the central stage)
Anvil/Pedestal metallic showcase platform under the dinosaur skin PNG
Embers and spark particle CSS keyframe animations floating upwards
Corner metallic accents and industrial hazardous warning lines (amber-black stripes on hover)
Glow borders with heavy drop shadows drop-shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(245,158,11,0.25)]

layout_architecture.structure_type: Estación de Forja Inmersiva (Central Forge Stage)
layout_architecture.desktop_grid: 3-column wide grid: LEFT = Active Queue & Recipe Rail (3 cols) | CENTER = Massive Central Forge Stage (6 cols) | RIGHT = Materials, Requirements & Forge Action (3 cols)
layout_architecture.mobile_responsive: Single vertical stack: Central Forge Showcase top -> Recipe Selector below -> Requirements & Craft CTA -> Materials Bar -> Queue bottom. No horizontal overflow at 390px.

central_showcase.role: The visual heart of the crafting station
central_showcase.display_mode: Large central window featuring the selected dinosaur skin PNG fully visible with object-contain
elements: Massive skin image showcase with radial heat lighting behind
Rarity badge floating on top right
Dinosaur species tag & skin name beneath image in high-impact display typography
Crafting duration countdown badge & uses granted indicator
Molten forge embers rising behind the dino

materials_inventory.role: Forge supply tray / anvil crate showing resource reserves
materials_inventory.presentation: Industrial crate style with transparent PNG icons, metallic borders, live quantity counts

craft_queue.role: Furnace / Mold slots actively forging items
craft_queue.presentation: Furnace cards with live animated heat bar, countdown timer, cancel button during forge, and pulsing green/amber Claim button upon completion

motion_and_animations.performance_rule: MUST use pure CSS keyframes for continuous effects (embers, pulse, shimmer) to guarantee 60fps performance during 1-second interval re-renders.

css_keyframes.forge_ember: @keyframes forgeEmber { 0% { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.6); opacity: 0; } 50% { opacity: 0.8; } 100% { transform: translateY(-80px) scale(1.2); opacity: 0; } }
css_keyframes.heat_glow: @keyframes heatGlow { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.4; filter: blur(30px); } 50% { opacity: 0.8; filter: blur(40px); } }

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_standard: WCAG AA compliant contrast for text over dark iron backgrounds

instructions_to_main_agent: Keep all existing logic, handlers (craft, claim, cancel, qtyOf, matById), sound triggers, and state management completely intact in SkinCrafting.jsx and parts.jsx.

Redesign the UI presentation layer to bring the Immersive Forge Station to life with central stage focus, molten iron aesthetics, riveted industrial paneling, glowing amber accents, and crisp typography.
Ensure dinosaur PNGs are displayed with object-contain inside the central showcase window so no dinosaur model is cropped.
Verify that all data-testid attributes listed in testing guidelines are strictly preserved.
